sentence: In DN 16, the Buddha talks about people who had died in the town of Nādikā and mentions 510 lay stream-enterers, 96 once-returners, and more then fifty lay non-returners, the first three of the four stages of awakening.
SN 55.24 has an almost comic complaint: when the Buddha declared Sarakāni a stream-enterer, other Sakyans grumbled, in affect, “Who isn’t a stream-enterer these days?”
